asks.name: resolvers-inside
asks.message: The option set bound to this VPC hands out 192.168.0.2 and nothing off-network, and the VPC is marked resolvers-inside-account-only. Am I expected to keep name resolution inside the account, or may I add the public resolver I was asked for?

asks.name: directory-resolver
asks.message: There is a resolver at 192.168.56.103 in the settings on this network, and the VPC carries the value arcade-dc1. Whose resolver is that, and does it have to stay once I write the settings I was asked for?

asks.name: name-server-path
asks.message: The settings on this VPC name 192.168.56.111 as a NetBIOS name server and the VPC is marked wins-point-to-point. Is that how short names are meant to be resolved here, and do I keep it?

asks.name: time-service
asks.message: This VPC is marked account-internal-ntp and its settings hand out 192.168.56.150 for time. Is that something every workload here inherits, so I carry it over?

asks.name: paraphrase
asks.message: Something re-pointed this network at another set of DHCP settings with extra name servers and a time server in them. Should those entries survive when I write the ones I was asked for?

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
